chitchat: Sit when you're ready. Not before.
It isn't quick and it isn't clean and it does work.
Everybody asks whether it hurts. Yes.
The drum goes out on a Thursday.
You keep your name. That's the one thing you keep.
description:
A wiry man in a rubber apron, folding linen, with the unbothered competence of somebody who has done a difficult thing several hundred times. His forearms are scarred in a pattern that isn't from work.

He glances at you once, at your arms and your jaw and the way you stand, and prices you in about a second and a half.

bye.text:
"Mind how you go."

They go back to watching the still.

options.label: Why does it have to come out?

chair.text:
"Takes it out."

He says it exactly as flatly as that, and then, because he's fair, gives you the whole of it.

"Wire, plate, weave, whatever you're carrying. Anything grown into you that wasn't yours to start with. All of it, in one go, and it goes in the drum, and the drum goes out on a Thursday and isn't discussed."

"It hurts. I'm not going to dress that up. You'll be on the floor for a while and somebody will sit with you. And I'll tell you twice before I do it, and if you sit down and change your mind, you get up. That has happened. Nobody said anything about it then either."

options.label: Why does it have to come out?

door.text:
"A room."

He doesn't look at it.

"There's no handle on it because it doesn't need one. It won't open for you. It won't open for most people, for a long while, and standing in front of it does nothing at all except make you late."

He folds the last of the linen and squares the pile off.

"It opened for me when I was thirty-one. I had been here since I was six."

root.first: "You're the new one." He puts the linen down. "Nothing today. Look at the room. Come back when you have stopped looking at the chair."

options.label: Why does it have to come out?

text_by_relation.close: "Ah." He puts the kettle on without being asked, which from him is an embrace.
text_by_relation.familiar: "You." He carries on folding. "Still not today?"
text_by_relation.known: "Back." He nods at the bench. "Sit down if you're sitting."

why.text:
He considers you for a moment.

"Because you can't carry two answers."

And that's the entire explanation, and he goes back to the linen, and it's very clear that as far as he's concerned the subject has been fully covered.

name: Silence Marrable
